installed_build: Owner-confirmed V20; POLISH21/STORY22 not yet installed or newly packaged.
review_method: Primary AI review across8simulated lenses plus an existing independent AI helper for critic/musician critique and scope sanity check. Current source and retained native originals only; no fresh runtime, human review, audio listening or physical Android test.

personas.strength: A coherent grassroots-band setting, persistent people and an appealing poster identity.
personas.finding: The first week risks feeling like navigating activity screens; repeat prompts and generic aftermath weaken anticipation and payoff.
personas.recommendation: Make one complete band week carry specific choices into the next conversation, show and invitation.
personas.confidence: Source/pixels support repetition and disclosure findings; enjoyment/replay claims require human play.

personas.strength: Four-bar scope is manageable, saved arrangement identity exists and originals remain protected.
personas.finding: Fourteen phrase families are not fifty personal snippets per musician or alternate performances. Tone/balance/entrances differ from changing the playing. Stage advice currently changes modeled reception, not recordings.
personas.recommendation: Listen to the existing pool first, then make a small compatible kit whose phrases can be compared and retained in a saved song. Add short clearly identified stage excerpts.
personas.confidence: Asset design and playback placement reviewed; musical quality/isolation/key/bar-grid/loop suitability not assessed by ear.

personas.strength: Printed choices, restrained small edges, real musician portraits and fixed decision docks support the accepted direction.
personas.finding: Chat repeats the same agreement in notice, summary and transcript; multiple navigation layers add scrolling. Wide chat leaves substantial empty space. Named post-show consequences are in detailed narrative below generic summary metrics.
personas.recommendation: One main thread and primary next step, expandable history, prominent named aftermath, and selective wide-layout adjustment. Preserve poster artwork and inspect new defects before changing it.
personas.confidence: Direct source and retained pixel review; no new usability observation.

personas.strength: Plans can be remembered as kept, missed or strained, with current commitments available.
personas.finding: Three topics and shared four-day replies provide scaffolding but limited individual voice. Pending plans block every new topic instead of offering a useful check-in or renegotiation. The same two peer bands recur.
personas.recommendation: Author three contrasting musician situation chains, check-ins around a pending plan, and one reciprocal scene callback using existing people/history.
personas.confidence: Confirmed source limitations; proposed content, not a claim of implementation.

personas.strength: Original economic commitments and once-only settlement are preserved.
personas.finding: Pitch changes dialogue but _offer does not use it to change terms/obligations. Watching/helping grant the same support/contact/fan benefit, while helping alone adds fatigue. A tired push promise is classified from initial intent/fatigue even if actual rehearsal is gentle.
personas.recommendation: Fix intent-versus-action fairness first; make pitches and scene choices have distinct, contextual purposes with verifiable later consequences.
personas.confidence: Code-path findings confirmed by source inspection; no new runtime reproductions in this planning task.

personas.strength: Genre examples can be heard early; next-step buttons now lead into real activities.
personas.finding: A new player needs to understand who is free, what was promised and why the next action matters without repeatedly visiting several screens.
personas.recommendation: Surface one current commitment/opportunity on Home and return to the correct person or activity; keep prices/time explicit and future nonfinancial outcomes uncertain.
personas.confidence: A usability hypothesis requiring first-time-player observation, not an assertion that players are confused.

personas.strength: Written equivalents, reduced-motion paths and native touch cancellation have existing proof.
personas.finding: Desktop emulation does not prove Android comfort, actual text scaling, interruption behavior or long-scroll handling. Dialogue-heavy screens increase reading load.
personas.recommendation: Check phone touch/large-text/contrast/focus and audio interruptions; keep readable written context and reduced-motion equivalence.
personas.confidence: Known verification gap, not a measured new device failure.

personas.strength: Latest source has four-view and atomic-save evidence with separate installed-app identity.
personas.finding: The owner still has V20; POLISH21/STORY22 are source-only. New native coverage focuses on an opening-slot band; higher-status cases are model oracles. Strong check counts do not establish fun, listening quality or Android performance.
personas.recommendation: Integrate the completed source into the same-app baseline; test multi-day and returning-band cases, then one combined review release per coherent update using the original signing workflow.
personas.confidence: Current documented delivery/proof state, not a fresh APK audit.

recommendation: Two substantial updates: A closes the living band/local-scene loop and delivers the accumulated source; B deepens audible short-song authorship after the existing material is reviewed.

work_packages.title: Fair and distinct consequences
work: Resolve push/strain from actual session direction, attendance and observed condition rather than only the earlier promise. Keep old saved outcomes unchanged.
Give watching, helping and looking after your own band different contextual uses. Derive later favor/advice/availability from the recorded action; do not make every line a stat reward.
Make promoter pitches affect a supported commitment, eligible terms, bill position or follow-up. Keep existing fee/travel/cancellation policies unless separately versioned.
acceptance: Exhausted→gentle and exhausted→hard sessions have factually correct remembered outcomes; legacy reports without direction evidence are handled explicitly.
Same standing/venue with two supported pitches can produce a distinct obligation/offer/follow-up, verified from actual records. No audience attendance is invented from fan counts.
Watching, helping and protecting your own band each have a credible use in at least one situation. No universal best choice or pre-choice stat answer key.
Old saves, future-data holds, stale input, repeat actions and complete save-failure rollback remain intact.

work_packages.title: People and a local scene that remember
work: Use three contrasting existing musicians for focused authored situations: creative contribution, making time around work, and fatigue/trust. Use the owner-selected band when choosing the pilot roster.
Allow useful check-ins and explicit plan revision while an agreement is pending; preserve its history and prevent repeat reward farming.
Add one later encounter where a peer band/promoter explicitly remembers a specific earlier action. Reuse the two established acts before expanding the cast.
Bring the relevant promise/opportunity into Home and lead aftermath with named reactions before optional metrics.
acceptance: Two musicians respond differently to the same actual session for supported reasons.
A kept, missed or renegotiated plan affects a later scene and provides a usable player route.
One later opportunity or practical favor names the earlier person/action/receipt; it resolves once and survives reload.
A player can find the current plan and explain one visible cause-and-effect chain without opening the full ledger. Human comprehension needs actual playtest evidence.

work_packages.title: One clear poster journey in the same app
work: Condense repeated chat copy and navigation. Keep the musician, current situation, one primary next step and accessible return/history.
Preserve approved poster materials/large-frame texture, printed controls and source artwork; fix only evidenced small-control/readability/wide-layout issues.
Include already completed POLISH21 and STORY22. Check the actual app entry, install-over-existing compatibility, visible version identity and original save directory.

Run four native sizes plus physical Android touch, Continue, background/foreground, call/headphone/audio-focus and memory/load responsiveness checks when the review candidate exists. Make one combined release at the end of Update A.
acceptance: No essential choice is hidden behind an unrelated disclosure; long content remains reachable and readable.
Reduced motion and written/audio alternatives retain equivalent information; selected/disabled/focused states and large text remain legible.

Install the same com.bandmaster.ownerplaytest.s40 app with version code above20 using the original certificate; retain existing saves and verify payload/certificate through the established signing workflow.
Report device measurements/observations rather than infer phone latency or comfort from desktop tests.

work_packages.priority: Next substantial update after A feedback
work_packages.title: Hear ownership of a short song
work: Audit and listen to the existing14 families before requesting more Suno material. Label phrase identity, source, tempo/key/bar-grid confidence, isolation and endings honestly.
Build one small compatible four-bar kit with distinct playable ideas per instrument where available. Use real alternate playing only when the asset contains it. Preserve the high-quality originals.

Keep permanent character audition samples separate from consumed song phrases. Use free A/B comparison, then existing paid first-commit consumption; retain saved phrase bindings through roster changes.
Make a short saved-song stage excerpt follow the saved arrangement. Playback/mute/interruption must not drive or duplicate performance settlement.

Only after the existing pool is reviewed, make a narrow missing-part brief for one shortlisted Suno generation/unlock at a time within the owner-stated60-song monthly budget. Preview before unlocking/stemming/downloading.
acceptance: A player can hear a distinct phrase choice and recognize it after save/reload and on stage. Listening evidence is required; numerical/runtime analysis is insufficient.
Compatible parts have verified bar boundaries/tempo/key as applicable and clean transitions; uncertainty is retained where not verified.
Audition replay remains permanent/free; consumption occurs only at the existing paid songwriting commitment. Old songs keep exact phrases after roster changes.
Stage excerpts identify the saved song, stop cleanly and leave scoring/Finance/save settlement independent.
No blanket50-snippets-per-character rollout, full-song editor, cosmetic EQ labelled as alternate playing, or unbounded generation batch.

release_sequence: Planning now; no code/build/release in this turn.

Update A: establish current source integration baseline; fix fairness and scene-choice differentiation; add a small set of distinctive character/follow-up scenes; focused poster UX and actual-device review; one combined release.
Review real owner/player feedback, then Update B: compatible four-bar musical kit and saved-song stage excerpts; one combined release after listening/asset acceptance.
example_player_journey: A musician asks for a manageable evening → player chooses a song idea and an actual available rehearsal → people react to what happened → promoter discusses a credible support slot → player judges advice and chooses how to support another act → named aftermath acknowledges those choices → a later conversation or invitation remembers one specific earlier action.
deferred: Fifty snippets per character or exhaustive eighteen-character dialogue expansion.
All fourteen genres receiving recordings in one batch.
More generic venue/band lists before existing contacts have distinct roles and payoffs.
Whole-song editor, hardware mixing-desk UI, runtime/free-text AI chat, extra economy/management subsystems or broad poster redesign.
New raw audio publication, replacement app/signing key or changes to original files.
guardrails: Uncertainty before decisions: show situation and explicit prices/time, keep future nonfinancial bonuses/odds hidden; explain actual saved outcomes afterward.
Browsing/listening/local comparisons remain free; preserve canonical booking, Finance, save and phrase-consumption boundaries.
Do not retrospectively manufacture biographies, attendance, prior chats, bands or successes. Preserve legacy/future/unknown data deliberately.
Keep private audio out of public Git and preserve original sources. Commercial interactive-game licensing remains a separate existing clarification before shipping.
No arbitrary review scores, claimed human persona panel or musical-quality verdict without listening.
evaluation: Distinct supported choices and understandable consequences, not feature/test counts.
Actual first-time-player ability to find the next meaningful action and recall why a later scene occurred.
Listening/recognition of a saved musical choice when Update B is evaluated.
Physical phone responsiveness and lifecycle continuity in the combined app, with measured observations.
independent_review: Existing AI helper agrees with the two-chunk ranking; requests explicit gentle/hard/legacy push tests, verifiable pitch commitments without invented attendance, contextual scene-option value, permanent audition vs paid phrase-use distinction, stage playback independent from settlement and separate technical/listening/owner/shipping gates.
next_action: Start Update A with the narrow actual-session promise-fairness correction and its gentle/hard/legacy counterexamples, on the verified existing source; carry the completed polish/chat work into the one combined review candidate.

planning_validation.issue_disposition: Review complete; push fairness and consequential-choice findings remain OPEN for Update A.
planning_validation.criteria: Two bounded updates with acceptance conditions, source/installed distinction and explicit simulated evidence.
